from pathlib import Path

p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    colored = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    top = min(r for r, c in colored)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in colored)
    left = min(c for r, c in colored)
    right = max(c for r, c in colored)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, c in colored if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    if not markers:
        return out
    mr, mc = markers[0]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            out[r][c] = 4
    radius = 2
    while True:
        ring_has_cells = False
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                if max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc)) == radius:
                    out[r][c] = 2
                    ring_has_cells = True
        if not ring_has_cells and radius > max(bottom - top, right - left):
            break
        radius += 2
    out[mr][mc] = 3
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), ns)
transform=ns['transform']
